subject: Final MAP, signature window and Day 0 kickoff plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara@ferris.ai>, Sparrow Retail Procurement <procure@sparrowretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP (v3) and preferred signature windows / Day 0 options

Hi Clara / Sparrow procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive eval sessions last week. Attached is the MAP v3 and the SOW draft that incorporates the performance SLAs and the two-week canary we discussed. High level asks from our side: a formal go/no-go confirmation and an agreement on the signature window so we can lock resources and the onboarding calendar.

Key dates (requested):
- Final go/no-go confirmation: Mon, Feb 22 EOD PT
- Preferred e-sign window: Wed, Mar 3 — Fri, Mar 5 (we can accommodate March 3rd morning if Sparrow prefers)
- Target Day 0 (first onboarding / kickoff): Tue, Mar 8

Attachments: Sparrow-MAP-v3.pdf, Sparrow-SOW-draft.docx, SOC2-evidence-request-list.xlsx

Notes/asks:
1) Please confirm whether Sparrow requires a PO before signature or if DocuSign countersign + post-sign PO is acceptable.
2) If legal has any redlines, send them back by COB Feb 22 so we can incorporate and circulate final SOW for signature.
3) We propose a 2-week canary (10 seats) as outlined in the MAP to validate latency/cost targets before full ramp.

If helpful, we can host a 15-minute sync tomorrow to walk the MAP changes.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Clara Jensen <clara@ferris.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sparrow Retail Procurement <procure@sparrowretail.com>, Ben Torres <b.torres@sparrowretail.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP (v3) and preferred signature windows / Day 0 options

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for sending the MAP and SOW. Quick notes from procurement/legal:
- Procurement prefers a signed SOW + PO before any paid work starts. We can issue the PO same day as the signed DocuSign SOW, but legal needs to review final terms.
- Ben (legal) will push a short list of redlines; at a minimum they will ask for a liability cap and a data retention clause adjusted to 90 days for test caching.
- SOC2 evidence — we need the items listed in the SOC2-evidence-request-list.xlsx to be confirmed before execution. If Redwood can drop a link to a shared evidence repo, that speeds review.

Availability for signature: we can do DocuSign on Wed, Mar 3 or Thu, Mar 4. If you can get final SOW to us by Feb 22, we will prioritize review.

Also, confirming the canary is fine — procurement wants the measurable acceptance criteria in the MAP (latency p95, cost per 1k tokens) to be explicit.

Clara
Head of Platform, Ferris AI
clara@ferris.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP (v3) and preferred signature windows / Day 0 options

Karthik / Monica —

Looping in internal ops considerations after reading Clara's note:
- Legal redlines: we should prepare a tracked SOW that contains a narrow liability cap and explicit data handling language. Monica, can you coordinate with Legal to get a clean tracked draft by Feb 21?
- SOC2 evidence: Ops can assemble the list; I can provide access to the evidence folder (audit logs, retention policy docs) by EOD Feb 21. Recommend we include a short evidence readout doc that legal can consume quickly.
- Signature and onboarding logistics: procurement wanting PO + signed SOW before start suggests we should ask for DocuSign on Mar 3 and target Day 0 (kickoff) for Mar 8 to give finance time to issue PO and engineering time to reserve the onboarding slot.
- Canary approach: propose the 2-week pilot with these acceptance criteria spelled out in the MAP: p95 < 400ms (regional), avg cost per 1k tokens <= $X (see MAP). If those pass, we move to full onboarding ramp.

Action items for us:
1) Monica: produce final tracked SOW with liability/data retention updates (due Feb 21).
2) Marcus: create a short evidence-readout doc + Drive link (due Feb 21).
3) Karthik: plan a 15-minute handoff call for Mar 3 afternoon (post-sign) if they want an immediate kickoff alignment.

— Marcus
Director, Implementation Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Hi Clara / Ben / Procurement —

Following internal alignment, attached is MAP v3 (clean) and the SOW with the narrow liability and 90-day test cache retention language included. Monica and Marcus are preparing the evidence-readout; I'll post the Drive link now so legal can access the SOC2-related items immediately.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4dMAP-Sparrow

We are blocking DocuSign on Wed, Mar 3 at 10:00 AM PT for countersign. Proposed Day 0 kickoff: Tue, Mar 8. We will treat the first two weeks as canary (10 seats) with acceptance criteria described in the MAP. If Sparrow signs on Mar 3, our onboarding team will be ready to run the kickoff on Mar 8.

Please confirm the following by EOD Mon, Feb 22:
- Legal ok with liability cap language as drafted
- Procurement confirms PO timing (same day as signed SOW is acceptable)
- If DocuSign on Mar 3 works for you, we will send the envelope and mark resources reserved.
